faqs.question: What geographic areas in Kerala does Oscar Logistics cover?
faqs.answer: We provide end-to-end transport and logistics coverage across all 14 revenue districts of Kerala—from Kasaragod in the north to Thiruvananthapuram in the south, including high-range routes in Idukki and Wayanad.

faqs.question: How can I track the exact location of my cargo in transit?
faqs.answer: Every vehicle in our fleet is fitted with satellite GPS telematics. Once your consignment is dispatched, our 24×7 dispatch desk shares a live tracking link and automated WhatsApp transit checkpoints until delivery.

faqs.question: How are freight rates calculated?
faqs.answer: Rates are calculated based on origin, destination distance (km), vehicle payload capacity (e.g. Tata Intra vs 407), and cargo nature. We provide upfront, transparent quotations with zero hidden fuel surcharges or surprise tolls.

faqs.question: Do you provide both Full Truck Load (FTL) and Part Truck Load (PTL)?
faqs.answer: Yes! Whether you need a dedicated truck strictly for your goods (FTL) or want to save money by sharing space for a few cartons or pallets (PTL), we have dedicated scheduled operations for both.

faqs.question: How do you protect cargo from monsoon rains and road bumps in Kerala?
faqs.answer: All our vehicles carry triple-layer heavy waterproof industrial tarpaulins, rubberized edge protectors, and ratcheted cargo lashing belts to guarantee zero moisture ingress and zero shifting.

faqs.question: How fast can I get a truck dispatched for immediate pickup?
faqs.answer: For urgent express bookings within major logistics clusters like Kochi, Thrissur, and Kozhikode, our trucks can arrive at your warehouse or shop floor within 60 to 90 minutes of confirmation.
